tags.name: BLM Dispersed Camping
Campsite 1 - Deep Creek
tags.note: At the confluence of Deep Creek. The site is located on the left side of the river. This site has a maximum group size of 4 and is available for reservations online or on a walk-up basis.

tags.name: Campsite 2 - River Bend
tags.note: A 10-15 minute walk beyond Deep Creek, River Bend is located on the right side of the point of a sharp bench 10 feet above the river. This site has a maximum group size of 4 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 3 - Right Bench
tags.note: A 10-15 minute walk beyond Deep Creek, River Bend is located on the right side of the point of a sharp bench 10 feet above the river. This site has a maximum group size of 6 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 4 - Flat Rock
tags.note: Flat Rock is a 5-10 minute walk beyond Right Bench, located beside a large flat rock next to the river. The site is next to the rock, on a 6 foot high bench next to the canyon wall. This site has a maximum group size of 2 and is available for walk-up perm

tags.name: Campsite 5 - Ringtail
tags.note: Flat Rock is a 5-10 minute walk beyond Right Bench, located beside a large flat rock next to the river. The site is next to the rock, on a 6 foot high bench next to the canyon wall. This site has a maximum group size of 2 and is available for walk-up perm

tags.name: Campsite 6 - Kolob Creek
tags.note: At the confluence of Kolob Creek. The site is located on the right side, 20 feet above the river on a bench. This site has a maximum group size of 12 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 7 - Box Elder
tags.note: A 10 minute walk beyond Kolob Creek. This site is located on the left about 30 feet up on a bench. This site has a maximum group size of 6 and is available for reservations online or on a walk-up basis.

tags.name: Campsite 8 - Boulder Camp
tags.note: Across the river from Box Elder, a 10 minute walk beyond Kolob Creek around a sharp bend. The access trail is to the right up slope about 50 feet. This site has a maximum group size of 6 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 9 - Left Bench
tags.note: Across the river from Box Elder, a 10 minute walk beyond Kolob Creek around a sharp bend. The access trail is to the right up slope about 50 feet. This site has a maximum group size of 6 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 10 - West Bend
tags.note: A 5 minute hike from Left Bench. This site is on a high bank located on a western bend. This site has a maximum group size of 6 and is available for walk-up permit only.

tags.name: Campsite 11 - Spotted Owl
tags.note: This sunny site is located on the left side, immediately after the first stream crossing. It is up a slope 10 feet above the river. This site has a maximum group size of 4 and is available for walk-up permit only.
